findings.summary: ghUsageReport groups lines with `byToken.set(token, [...(byToken.get(token) ?? []), c])`, which copies the whole array for every line. On the operator's real ledger that is about 2.4e10 element copies for one weekly report. A benchmark of the same pattern took 4.9 s for 60k lines, so `cli-hierarchy gh-usage report --since 7d` would take minutes or run out of memory. Failure scenario: the operator runs the report to attach to a dependency-limit:github escalation (AISDLC-1438) and the command stalls. Fix: `let a = byToken.get(token); if (!a) byToken.set(token, (a = [])); a.push(c);`. The fixture tests are too small to catch this.
